pr_title: net: socket: fix regression causing corrupted poll timeout
pr_body:
k_timeout_t was converted to ticks using a nonsense function
causing poll timeout corruption for offloaded sockets; this
commit uses ticks directly from the struct instead.

Fixes #37472

issue_context.title: Corrupted timeout on poll for offloaded sockets
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
When pulling latest Zephyr for our project, I noticed that `poll()` suddenly went from blocking for 10ms to 30000ms. It seems like [this PR](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/36220) is causing this timeout corruption with this addition:
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/ca5921845d4241ce9da9496a8e97d7dd6c1c4bae/subsys/net/lib/sockets/sockets.c#L1455-L1462

It seems like the intention is to convert ticks to ms, but the function `sys_clock_timeout_end_calc` returns **at which tick in the future the timeout will happen**. For the argument K_NO_WAIT it simply returns `sys_clock_tick_get()` with the definition
> Return the current system tick count
So instead of waiting 10ms, it waits for as long as the program has been running previously, plus 10ms, is my interpretation.

I'm not sure if this was the intention, but further down `poll_timeout` is used as time in *ms* as argument for `k_sem_take()`, at least in 
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/ca5921845d4241ce9da9496a8e97d7dd6c1c4bae/drivers/modem/modem_socket.c#L307

Hence why it blocks for 30000ms.

Is my conclusion correct?

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Create offloaded socket
2. Run the program for a while
3. poll(..., ..., 10) and it will block  for as long as it has run

**Expected behavior**
Poll timeout should be intact when passed down

**Impact**
Showstopper

**Logs and console output**
N/A but it returns from poll() after 30s

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Commit SHA 997bbcb000c35f1d0de90668bb824bcce594daed
- SARA-R4 is the offloaded socket, and it is used behind a DTLS socket
comments: Indeed, the `k_timeout_t` to ms conversion doesn't seem right in this case and was somehow overlooked in the original PR. I think that your proposal looks right, feel free to submit a PR!
PR created, my unit tests pass with the fix :)

review_comments: Should`poll_timeout` be expressed as ticks? It seems that it should be a value in ms where anything < 0 is "infinity".

I'm not sure I understand the comment; please see https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/36220/files where this function was changed from receiving ms to receiving ticks to support microseconds. But since `z_fdtable_call_ioctl` expects ms, it is here converted back to ms, including the case in which `timeout` is `K_FOREVER` then `poll_timeout` is set to `-1` like you said it should. Sorry if I misunderstood.
